package: @astryxdesign/core

# DropdownMenuRadioGroup

Use DropdownMenuRadioGroup inside compound-mode DropdownMenu when several commands represent one mutually exclusive choice. Keep value in caller state, provide a concise accessible label, and render each choice as DropdownMenuRadioItem.

Anatomy: Group, Radio items

## Import

```tsx
import { DropdownMenuRadioGroup } from '@astryxdesign/core/DropdownMenu';
```

## Best Practices

- **Do:** Keep value controlled and update it from onChange so checked state follows caller data.
- **Do:** Provide a concise label even when aria-labelledby points to visible text; label remains required and supplies the aria-label fallback.
- **Do:** Set hasCloseOnSelect=false only when the menu must stay open to show another selection or an in-place result.
- **Don't:** Place buttons, links, checkboxes, or arbitrary menu rows inside the radio group.
- **Don't:** Add a second key handler or roving-focus model; DropdownMenu owns keyboard navigation.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `value` | `string \| undefined` | - | The currently selected value in the group. Pass undefined when nothing is selected yet. **(required)** |
| `onChange` | `(value: string) => void` | - | Callback fired when the selected value changes. **(required)** |
| `label` | `string` | - | Accessible name for the group, applied as aria-label so screen readers announce the radios as a named set, e.g. "Sort by". Required even when aria-labelledby (via base props) points to visible text; that visible reference becomes the computed name while label remains the fallback. **(required)** |
| `hasCloseOnSelect` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether selecting a value closes the menu. Radio items default to closing on selection (a single-choice commit). |
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | - | Ref forwarded to the role="group" root. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | - | The DropdownMenuRadioItems that make up the group. **(required)** |
